g.text: 39a · Grounded context authorization and query routing
Send chat question with shared Reel in conversation
Stream question with conversation history to AI Service
Verify user authorization for shared Reels in conversation
Return list of authorized, media-ready and indexed Reel IDs
Route query intent: REEL_GROUNDED, GENERAL_CHAT, or NO_CONTEXT
Return routing decision and search parameters
If no Reel is shared or query is general chat, router cleanly bypasses vector pipeline
